sections.content_text: Section 14 - Exercise of Power of Tribunal by the Benches (1) The powers and functions of the Appellate Tribunal shall be exercisable by the Benches of the Tribunal, hereinafter referred to as the Benches, unless exceptional decisions are made in any special case or class of cases constituted by the President. (2) The Bench constituted under sub-section (1) shall consist of at least 2 (two) members. (3) At least one member of each Bench constituted under sub-section (1) shall be appointed from among the following persons, namely:- (a) a member of the National Board of Revenue, or (b) Commissioner of Taxes.
